subject.title: [AI] fix(codex): strip internal webchat channel so heartbeat turns can send cross-provider

question: Should this PR remain a landing candidate because of its extra outbound diagnostic event, or should the primary Codex fix stay on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102232 with observability handled separately?
rationale: The primary regression already has a stronger open fix candidate, while this branch adds a new diagnostic payload surface that is useful but currently type-broken and not proven in real behavior output.

options.title: Use canonical fix and split observability
options.body: Keep the primary regression fix on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102232 and request a narrow follow-up for typed, proven cross-context denial diagnostics.

options.title: Adopt this branch after repair
options.body: Require the contributor to fix the diagnostic event contract, add redacted real log/live-output proof, and then re-review this PR against the canonical candidate.

options.title: Drop the diagnostic layer
options.body: Treat the diagnostic event as nonessential for this regression and supersede this PR once the primary fix lands elsewhere.

recommendation.title: Use canonical fix and split observability
recommendation.body: Keep the primary regression fix on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102232 and request a narrow follow-up for typed, proven cross-context denial diagnostics.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice is about the outbound policy diagnostic surface and containment-guard semantics, where steipete is the strongest history-backed owner candidate.
